style.north_star: Product truth first, emotion without manipulation, proof before polish.
style.brand: Evercraft master-brand architecture; product identity distinct; no unauthorized third-party marks.
style.motion: Kinetic editorial typography, precise UI choreography from real captures, practical human story, no fake dashboards or fabricated testimonials.
style.voice: Naturally paced recorded human speech, variable stresses and releases; never robotic phrase endings; signed voice rights before publishing.
style.music: Evercraft-authored composition or licensed stems with rights receipts. Silence can be more effective than stock crescendos.
style.audio: Target platform-specific loudness, review mix for mobile, captions with verified text
style.shot_evidence: Capture real authorized product interaction or explicitly label conceptual UI; do not stage real customer results.
style.publishing: owner approval required; all campaigns internally staged, none auto-posted
